BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry Property Consultants are delighted to bring to the market this exceptional 4/5 bedroom detached residence in the sought after development of Boyne Lodge. This stunning property is situated in an excellent location within the development. The property which is situated in a quiet cul de sac of only 4 houses  overlooking the River Boyne comes to the market in walk in condition. Resting on a large corner site, this bright and spacious property which is not overlooked to either front or rear of the house offers a stylish and elegant interior and is in excellent decorative condition throughout. This is a great opportunity to acquire a property in a much sought after area and an opportunity not to be missed.

The accommodation briefly comprises of downstairs: entrance porch, entrance hall, bedroom/playroom/office, large sitting room, designer kitchen/dining room leading to south facing rear garden with patio area, downstairs WC and utility room. Upstairs comprises of 4 bedrooms - the master bedroom is en-suite and family bathroom. This property is heated by Gas Fired Central  Heating, double glazed windows and is fully alarmed. There is also an attic with the property. There is a cobble lock driveway with ample space for car parking. There is a walled in garden to the front of the property and walled in south facing gardens to the rear of the property also. There is also side access with this property.

Boyne Lodge is located less than ten minutes from Drogheda town centre. the property is also surrounded with an abundance of amenities including primary and secondary schools, Lourdes Hospital, shops, restaurants, sports clubs, and transport services such as the train and bus station and M1 Motorway.  This would make a fantastic family home. 
Viewing of this property by appointment with Laura Sherry
